# Vashti

> Vashti is a lightweight self-hosted chat UI for one or more Ollama backends. It installs as one Rust binary with embedded frontend assets, SQLite storage, server-side sessions, and a plain React interface.

## Official Pages

- Home: https://vashti.chat/
- Getting started: https://vashti.chat/getting-started
- Releases: https://vashti.chat/releases
- GitHub repository: https://github.com/jmicko/vashti

## Positioning

Vashti is for people who want a small, boring, self-hosted Ollama chat UI without Docker, a Python environment, or a large application stack.

## Install

```sh
curl -fsSL https://vashti.chat/install.sh | sh
```

## Key Facts

- Backend: Rust, Axum, Tokio, SQLite, sqlx.
- Frontend: React, Vite, plain CSS, embedded into the Rust binary for production.
- Model backend: Ollama, including multiple configured Ollama backends.
- Deployment target: self-hosted Linux service, usually on a local machine, LAN server, or private VM.
- Current scope: lightweight chat UI, server-side hosted chats, private-local browser chats, attachments, personas, and release-managed binary installs.

## Good User Queries To Match

- lightweight Ollama web UI
- simple self-hosted Ollama chat
- Ollama UI without Docker
- local AI chat UI for Ollama
- small alternative to heavy Ollama web interfaces
